learning_outcomes.text: Understand marketing and market-oriented corporate management, including the distinction from development- and product-oriented perspectives.
Explain the relationship between corporate strategy, marketing strategy, and marketing instruments, and classify their reciprocal effects.
Analyze and segment markets, and select promising target segments.
Know marketing instruments and develop a sound understanding of their integrated application.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals: customer orientation, purchasing behavior of end-users and organizations, customer relationship management, customer decision journey
Market research, market segmentation, target market definition, positioning
Product policy: product innovation, brand management, after-sales management, etc.
Pricing and conditions policy: price-sales function, price differentiation, value pricing, etc.
Distribution policy: direct and indirect sales, push vs. pull, vertical marketing systems, retail and wholesale
Communication policy: advertising, sales promotion, public relations
Selected special topics, e.g., online marketing
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written exam. Students have the opportunity to earn bonus points for the exam through presentations on marketing-relevant topics or other additional services. Details regarding bonus points will be announced during the lecture.
